claim: Qingping Market covers 11,200 sqm with over 1,200 booths selling 600+ varieties including Chinese herbal medicines, dried goods, seafood, dried fruits and flowers; nearest metro is Huangsha (Line 1/6), Exit B.
quote: Covering an area of 11,200 square meters and possessing over 1,200 booths... More than 600 varieties of meat, eggs and vegetables, seafood, Chinese herbal medicines, dried fruits, flowers, birds and fishes are sold... Take metro line 1 or line 6 and get down at Huangsha Station.

claim: Qingping Chinese Medicine Market is a recommended Guangzhou attraction stocked with countless dried herbs and flowers for teas and traditional remedies plus unique ingredients like peach gum and edible flowers.
quote: shelves stocked with countless dried herbs and flowers for teas and traditional remedies, as well as unique ingredients like peach gum and a wide selection of edible flowers for cooking and wellness

claim: Yide Road is the largest dried-seafood distribution center in Southeast Asia, selling dried abalone, conpoy (dried scallops), sea cucumber and fish maw, and is nicknamed the 'Wall Street' of dried seafood.
quote: When you step into Yide Road—the largest dried seafood distribution center in Southeast Asia—you will be surrounded by the rich aromas of dried abalone, conpoy (dried scallops), and fish maw

claim: Yide Road retail prices for abalone, sea cucumber, shark fin, fish maw, dried shrimp and scallops run 30-50% cheaper than supermarkets; shops open around 9:30 AM and close ~5:30 PM; metro Line 6 to Yide Road Station Exit A.
quote: retail prices are often 30% to 50% cheaper than in supermarkets or shopping malls. Shops usually open around 9:30 AM and close by about 5:30 PM... Take Metro Line 6 and get off at Yide Road Station (Exit A)

claim: For Spring Festival 2026 Guangzhou hosted 11 major flower markets with 2,655 stalls (up 7.7%), running Feb 10-17, with Yuexiu District's 'century-old flower market' as the most representative and the Canton Tower waterfront market running 13 days.
quote: The city will host 11 major flower markets with a total of 2,655 stalls, which is 7.7% more than last year... from February 10 and running until the early hours of February 17... Canton Tower waterfront market, which runs for 13 days

claim: The Xiguan antique market off Daihe Lu in Liwan District runs ~500m with 100+ businesses over ~8,553 sqm, dealing in old pottery and porcelain, calligraphy and paintings, the four treasures of study, and jade.
quote: The antique market is situated in the alleys off Daihe Lu... old pottery and porcelain, famous scripts and paintings throughout the ages, the four treasures of traditional study... and jade articles... length of 500 meters... more than 100 units, covering an area of about 8553 square meters

claim: Wende Road Culture Street in central Guangzhou is the city's main art/antique street for original calligraphy and paintings, home to the Guangzhou Cultural Relics Store (opened 1960), one of China's top four official cultural relic stores.
quote: Wende Lu Culture Street, where lots of original calligraphy and paintings as well reproductions of well-know paintings are within easy reach... Guangzhou Cultural Relics Store (opened in 1960) is one of China's official top four cultural relic stores
